name: Campingplatz Hiasenhof
beschreibung: The Campingplatz Hiasenhof is located in Thiersee, Tirol, Österreich. The surroundings are characterized by forests and mountains. Nearby there are ski areas and marked hiking trails. The site is quietly situated and used by guests for relaxation. The facilities include pitches, sanitary facilities and a children's playground. The area offers opportunities for hiking, cycling and skiing.
